historicalCrash.message: Can't use string ("[000006:000048:scriptTable_42_0/...") as an ARRAY ref while "strict refs" in use at lib/Test/Slim/ListExecutor.pm line 19.
historicalCrash.cause: A valid nested SLiM statement had an empty-string argument. _take_utf16_units consumed the following colon for a requested length of zero; nested list parsing failed and returned the encoded statement as a scalar. ListExecutor then dereferenced it as an arrayref. The fix avoids consuming any characters for zero units.

fixtureIncrement.upstreamBehavior: Installed FitNesse v20251025 PageDriver has an implicit no-argument constructor. Acceptance scenarios call createPageWithContent(String,String), makeATestPage(String), makeASuitePage(String), requestPage(String), content(), contentContains(String), contentMatches(String), and lineNumberContaining(String). Java PageCreator uses saveData; requestPage runs the requested responder and returns its status.
fixtureIncrement.perlBehavior: The Perl fixture posts saveData with editTime=9999999999999, ticketId=321, and pageContent; marks pages using saveProperties/PageType=Test; issues HTTP GET requests for the supplied page URI; retains status and body on the PageDriver and in a per-SLiM-process ResponseContext. HTTP status errors are retained; transport errors are raised as fixture exceptions.

scenarioActorInvestigation.rootCause: Executor defect, not a fixture or incorrect scenario binding. FitNesse library method lookup is newest-first after actor/SUT lookup; SlimHelperLibrary provides cloneSymbol and the actor stack helpers, and scenario steps use synthetic scriptTableActor calls.
scenarioActorInvestigation.expectedSemantics: If the named actor has no matching instance/method, registered libraries are searched newest-first. cloneSymbol returns its argument object unchanged, preserving symbol identity.
perlChanges: Missing scenario actor names now fall through to registered-library lookup before NO_INSTANCE.
The null-target cloneSymbol helper substitutes and returns its exact argument object.
scenarioActorInvestigation.diagnosticArrayText: Statement.pm debug warn interpolates nested arrayref arguments as ARRAY(0x...). This is diagnostic output only; the parsed nested list is serialized recursively for the socket frame.

conformanceSummary.interpretation: Raw page-level FitNesse counts are preserved separately. Pages with intentional wrong cells, exceptions, or ignored rows inside embedded tests are not considered conformant until their outer pages verify those outcomes. Fixture and harness blockers are not attributed to the SLiM engine without evidence.

classificationMethod: Each page retains raw right/wrong/ignored/exception counts. Conformance classification uses page content, inherited setup, embedded expected counts, current Perl fixtures, and upstream FitNesse documentation. Negative examples are evaluated by their outer assertions, not by assuming every inner failure is a defect.

observedFlow: PageDriver creates page content and marks pages as tests through FitNesse responders.
request_page calls ?test, ?suite, or ?executionLog and retains status/response content.
ResponseExaminer reads the current response or page HTML, applies multiline/dotall regular expressions, and returns the selected capture group.
Outer pages inspect embedded pass/fail/ignore/exception markup, counts, startup errors, and timeout output.

concurrencyVerification.model: fork one worker per accepted SLiM connection; listener parent accepts and reaps children
concurrencyVerification.isolation: Each process() call replaces EXEC with a fresh ListExecutor, isolating imports, actor objects, library registrations and instances, symbols, and fixture-owned state.
concurrencyVerification.socketCleanup: Parent closes its accepted-socket copy; process() closes the worker socket on BYE, EOF, or exception; malformed input is contained in the worker; SIGCHLD handler reaps exited workers.
